Asked whether he had made plans to meet with Jeffries and what bipartisan legislation could pass in the new Congress, Trump pointed to what he called the two “extreme powers” of the presidency.

“So, I don’t want to say who’s called, but various people have called from the Democrats,” Trump said during a press briefing. “Any president has two extreme powers,” the president continued. “One is the power of pardon, and the other is the power of the veto.” He then described how he expects things to go with Democrats in Congress. “So, they’re going to send things my way, and I’m going to veto them. At least six Chinese universities blacklisted by the US government have reported purchasing restricted Nvidia computer chips in recent years, a CNN review of business records found – highlighting US difficulties in controlling access to the in-demand technology. 

Two of those universities known for their ties to the Chinese military establishment reported buying the high-powered chips just in the last few months.

CNN's Kyung Lah has the details and former FBI counterintelligence official Frank Figliuzzi says the risk posed by the chip sales in China is "significant." Also, New York Times global technology correspondent Paul Mozur and CNN Newsnight's panel of political pundits discuss China's access to Nvidia chips.

author: CNN
description:
Russia launched a deadly attack on Ukraine overnight into Friday, hours after President Vladimir Putin met his US and Chinese counterparts for historic trilateral talks in which the three powers billed themselves as a force for peace in the world. Trump spoke with European leaders after the call, reportedly describing Putin as “tired” and ready for peace. But Kyiv said Russia fired at least 110 missiles overnight – an unusually large number even amid Russia’s frequent aerial assaults.

Nine people have been killed and at least 28 injured during the missile and drone attack which lasted more than ten hours, according to Ukrainian authorities. Some 400 drones, including 120 jet-powered drones which are essentially compact cruise missiles, were part of the attack. The Polish government said Polish and NATO fighter jets were scrambled and Patriot air defense systems were activated early on Friday after Poland’s airspace was violated during the attack, with “objects” flying in and falling
title: Russia hits Ukraine hours after Trump meets Putin
